sovereignty.intro: You decide where your store and your customers' data live.

options.title: In-house

options.title: Get expert advice

promiseItems: Your data, with no dependency on a vendor

found.leadHtml: Sylius Starter is a set of Castor commands (wait, what is Castor?) around a standard Sylius project. You create a project, then add or remove features as your needs evolve. Your project stays standard: any Symfony team can pick it up.

feats.html: sylius:init creates the project: Docker, Sylius, database, assets, fixtures and tests.
sylius:add installs, configures and migrates a plugin. sylius:remove takes it out again, configuration and migrations included.
sylius:theme:setup switches the whole store theme, removing the previous one first.
sylius:b2b:enable turns on B2B features, such as hiding prices.
sylius:menu:remove hides the back-office entries you don't need.

ecosystem.title: A proven foundation
ecosystem.intro: Sylius has been running demanding stores for more than ten years. E‑commerce expertise and a track record of projects that few solutions can match.

benefits.title: Community-driven
benefits.p: Partners, solution vendors and freelancers keep the project alive.

event.title: Meet us at PS Summit
event.p: The first open source event shared by PrestaShop and Sylius: workshops, technical talks and case studies. Come and talk to us about your project.

solutions.title: The solutions your store needs, already plugged in
solutions.intro: Payment, redirects, traffic analytics: our partners' solutions are added to your store in one command, already configured.

cards.title: redirection.io
cards.p: Keep your search rankings intact when you change stores, and manage your redirects without touching the code.

offer.intro: Services are delivered by independent Sylius partners. You deal with them directly.

plans.name: Custom store
plans.desc: Your partner builds your store with Sylius Starter: checkout, payment, shipping, search, design in your colours. It's live in a few days.

plans.name: Migration
plans.desc: Audit of your current store, transfer of your products, customers and orders, and a switchover without losing your search rankings. Pricing depends on volume and integrations.

offer.note: Maintenance and training are offered by partners depending on your project.
